_comment: Sprint 2 ratchet (2026-05-23). v1 route handlers that currently lack an openapi.json entry. The check-api-contracts gate fails when this list shrinks (route documented) without the JSON being trimmed, and fails when a new undocumented route appears outside this list. Ratchet down, never up. Remove a line as the route gets its spec entry; never add a new one — document new routes in openapi.json instead. 2026-06-02: every previously-grandfathered v1 route is now documented in openapi.json; list emptied.
